attractions.name: Mount Rigi
attractions.description: Known as the 'Queen of the Mountains', accessible by cogwheel train from Vitznau offering panoramic views of rolling green valleys, deep blue lakes, and layered Alpine peaks.
attractions.hours: Mountain railway operates throughout the day
attractions.entry_fee: Included with Swiss Travel Pass (or approx. ₹7,500–10,500 without pass)

transport_options.description: Famous cogwheel train from Vitznau to Mount Rigi. Approx. 35 mins uphill journey.
